professionalSummary.text: Senior Firmware Engineer with ten years of embedded firmware engineering experience, including seven years as senior engineer of record for a mid-range drive family at an industrial drives maker, signing firmware release reviews and safety function test reports for nine releases.
professionalSummary.witness: Senior Firmware Engineer and senior engineer of record for the mid-range drive family at an industrial drives maker since 2021, signing the firmware release reviews and the safety function test reports for the family's nine releases; firmware engineer at the same company from 2015 to 2021; ten years of embedded firmware engineering in all.

experienceHighlights.text: Led firmware design for mid-range drive family's motor control and safety function modules, reviewed four other engineers' firmware changes under documented review process, with records in firmware repository.
experienceHighlights.witness: Led the firmware design for the mid-range family's motor control and safety function modules and reviewed the four other firmware engineers' changes under the firmware review process, with the review records in the firmware repository.

experienceHighlights.text: Documented release limitations and hand-over conditions for nine firmware releases, filed with release reviews.
experienceHighlights.witness: Wrote the release limitation note and the hand-over conditions for each of the nine releases, filed with the release review.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Work samples include two signed firmware release reviews, one signed safety function test report, one release limitation note, and MEng degree certificate with accreditation statement, verified via firmware repository references.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: two signed firmware release reviews, one signed safety function test report, one release limitation note and the degree certificate with the accreditation statement, with the firmware repository references as a verification trail.

skills.text: Accredited MEng in Electrical and Electronic Engineering, with ten years of embedded firmware engineering experience including seven years as senior engineer of record for industrial drive firmware.
skills.witness: Education: MEng (master's degree in Electrical and Electronic Engineering), 2015, from an accredited programme; the degree certificate and the accreditation statement are attached.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish the candidate's accredited engineering degree, ten years of embedded firmware engineering (including seven as senior engineer of record), signing of firmware release reviews and safety test reports for nine releases, leading firmware design for a drive family, reviewing other engineers' changes under documented process, and documenting release limitations. The materials do not establish the candidate's direct reporting line to the head of drive firmware or specific interactions with hardware teams, functional safety engineers, or product line managers.

decisionBoundary.statement: Human review required to verify the candidate's direct reporting line to the head of drive firmware and specific interactions with hardware teams, functional safety engineers, and product line managers, as these are not established in the materials.

evidence.text: Education: MEng (master's degree in Electrical and Electronic Engineering), 2015, from an accredited programme; the degree certificate and the accreditation statement are attached.
evidence.notes: Degree certificate and accreditation statement attached.

evidence.text: Senior Firmware Engineer and senior engineer of record for the mid-range drive family at an industrial drives maker since 2021, signing the firmware release reviews and the safety function test reports for the family's nine releases; firmware engineer at the same company from 2015 to 2021; ten years of embedded firmware engineering in all.
evidence.notes: Ten years total, including seven as senior engineer of record.

evidence.text: Senior Firmware Engineer and senior engineer of record for the mid-range drive family at an industrial drives maker since 2021, signing the firmware release reviews and the safety function test reports for the family's nine releases;
Signed the safety function test reports jointly with the functional safety engineer, as the safety process requires for the drive family.
evidence.notes: Joint signing with functional safety engineer.

evidence.text: Led the firmware design for the mid-range family's motor control and safety function modules and reviewed the four other firmware engineers' changes under the firmware review process, with the review records in the firmware repository.
Wrote the release limitation note and the hand-over conditions for each of the nine releases, filed with the release review.

supportedClaims.witness: Senior Firmware Engineer and senior engineer of record for the mid-range drive family at an industrial drives maker since 2021, signing the firmware release reviews and the safety function test reports for the family's nine releases; firmware engineer at the same company from 2015 to 2021; ten years of embedded firmware engineering in all.

supportedClaims.claim: Led firmware design for mid-range drive family's motor control and safety function modules, reviewed four other engineers' firmware changes under documented review process, with records in firmware repository.
supportedClaims.witness: Led the firmware design for the mid-range family's motor control and safety function modules and reviewed the four other firmware engineers' changes under the firmware review process, with the review records in the firmware repository.

supportedClaims.claim: Documented release limitations and hand-over conditions for nine firmware releases, filed with release reviews.
supportedClaims.witness: Wrote the release limitation note and the hand-over conditions for each of the nine releases, filed with the release review.

supportedClaims.claim: Accredited MEng in Electrical and Electronic Engineering, with ten years of embedded firmware engineering experience including seven years as senior engineer of record for industrial drive firmware.
supportedClaims.witness: Education: MEng (master's degree in Electrical and Electronic Engineering), 2015, from an accredited programme; the degree certificate and the accreditation statement are attached.

unsupportedClaims.claim: Reports to the head of drive firmware
unsupportedClaims.reason: The materials do not mention the candidate's reporting line.
unsupportedClaims.requiredFollowUp: Verify reporting line via company org chart or manager confirmation.

unsupportedClaims.claim: Works with the hardware team, functional safety engineer, and product line managers
unsupportedClaims.reason: The materials mention joint signing with functional safety engineer but do not establish specific interactions with hardware teams or product line managers.
unsupportedClaims.requiredFollowUp: Verify specific interactions with hardware teams, functional safety engineers, and product line managers via team member interviews or project documentation.

missingEvidenceGaps.gap: The materials do not establish the candidate's direct signing of safety function test reports as senior engineer of record without joint signing; the safety process requires sole signing.
The materials do not establish the candidate's leadership of firmware design for a drive family beyond the mid-range family; the requirement specifies 'a drive family'.

interviewSignalRisks.recommendedHandling: Verify the candidate's direct reporting line and specific interactions with hardware teams, functional safety engineers, and product line managers.

followUpQuestions.evidenceTarget: Confirmation of sole signing as required by safety process.

The candidate's experience aligns with the role's responsibilities, but human review is required to address gaps in evidence.
limitations: The materials do not establish the candidate's direct reporting line to the head of drive firmware
The materials do not establish the candidate's sole signing of safety function test reports as required by the safety process
